391-2645-3147-3430.easyPrerequisites: Blossom Dryad doesn't have summoning sickness.
391-2645-3147-3430.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2957-4881-6909-8200.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
2957-4881-6909-8200.easyPrerequisites: Imagecrafter does not have summoning sickness.
2957-4881-6909-8200.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Carnage to become a Goblin until end of turn
Cast Grub's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 4, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 6.

1170-1976-2099-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1976-2099-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Etherium Sculptor.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

277-2557-4772-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2723-3356.description:
Deal damage to Polyraptor.
Polyraptor and Blazing Sunsteel trigger.
Resolve the Polyraptor trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing damage to Polyraptor.
Repeat from step 2.

215-4068-5614.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
215-4068-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Bighorner Rancher from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2097-5184-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

2438-6972-7768.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Chaotic Goo.
When Chaotic Goo dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

4067-6609-7736.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a nonland permanent you control
4067-6609-7736.description:
Activate O'aka by tapping it and removing a counter from a nonland permanent, causing you to draw a card.
Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings triggers, putting a counter on it.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping O'aka.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7706.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing White Widow.
When White Widow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When White Widow enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and up to one other creature.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

423-1437-3861-5478.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-3861-5478.description:
Cast Spelunking by paying {2}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Spelunking spell three times.
Resolve the first Spelunking copy.
The Spelunking token enters the battlefield, drawing a card then putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield untapped.
Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
In response, activate the land by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.
423-1437-3861-5478.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Spelunking. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

Repeat

856-5231-5776-6351.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Starnheim Courser.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Starnheim Courser.
Repeat.

323-5170-5231-6132.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

414-4613-6258.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
414-4613-6258.description:
Activate a creature using Grist's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token and mill a card, and then put a loyalty counter on the creature and repeat the process if the card was an Insect.
The Insect enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede, causing it to have Grist's abilities.
Repeat from step 1 using the Insect token instead.

997-2173-2932-5220.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
997-2173-2932-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
997-2173-2932-5220.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1414-2866-3967-4986.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

Activate King Macar by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, allowing you to exile a creature and create a Gold token if you do so.
Repeat.

745-2781.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Mirrorhall Mimic.
745-2781.description:
Cast Mirrorhall Mimic by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Mirrorhall Mimic enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Mirrorhall Mimic. Choose to have Mirrorhall Mimic enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

1253-3812-5963.description:

Activate Marvin using Simic Ragworm's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1124-1170-1283-2032-5261.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled with Isochron Scepter that does not remove a permanent and/or counter a spell, and that has legal targets, if needed.
Kiora has at least three loyalty counters on it.
1124-1170-1283-2032-5261.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an extra activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Kiora's loyalty ability twice by removing two loyalty counters from it, untapping Chromatic Orrery and Isochron Scepter.
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Kiora.
Resolve the copy of the instant card.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other permanent using Kiora, or use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

2092-2645-4657.notablePrerequisites:
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 5 or greater.
You control up to six lands that can tap to produce at least {6}.
Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
2092-2645-4657.description:
Activate up to six lands by tapping them, adding at least {6}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by tapping it and paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron, untapping the six lands.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities, or if you have infinite {R} and {G}, you may use it to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

"Rat" chosen with Xenograft.

When the Eldrazi Scion enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Xenograft, Lord Skitter's first ability triggers, exiling a card from an opponent's graveyard.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Eldrazi Scion, untapping a basic Forest you control.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

Activate Trazyn using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.

2645-3918-4131.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Staff of Domination's other abilities via Trazyn.

2034-4365-5189.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.

Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature token, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Prosperous Innkeeper, adding {C}{C}.
Prosperous Innkeeper dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Prosperous Innkeeper from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Prosperous Innkeeper enters the battlefield, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing those, adding two mana of any color.
Repeat.

864-3617-3742.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
864-3617-3742.description:
Cast Time Walk, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness that is tapped and attacking.
Eternal Witness enters, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Luminous Broodmoth, adding {G}.
Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Luminous Broodmoth enters the battlefield triggering Corpse Knight, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
